description: Search collector-car auction results and source links. Without login, returns up to five recent sold results using make/model filters. Sign in for full listing details, advanced filters, and pagination. Authenticated searches return completed auctions by default; status=coming soon opts into upcoming listings. Use pagination=cursor for sequential exports. Prices follow each source's premium convention.

body_style.description: Case-insensitive exact match to the returned body_style value using PostgreSQL lower(btrim(...)), which trims ordinary spaces from stored values. Queries are lowercased and trimmed; one nonblank value of 1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8 after normalization, without controls. No wildcards, aliases, or inference. Omit for no filter. Source labels vary and coverage is partial.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous live-dataset cursor page; changed records can repeat or be omitted

make.description: Normalized vehicle make from list_makes. Optional.

page.description: Deprecated page number. Use pagination=cursor for sequential traversal.

pagination.description: Pagination mode. cursor avoids exact counts and deep offsets.

seller_username.description: Exact seller username match. Omit make when using this alone.

sort.description: Sort field (default: date, ordered by auction_end_at)

source.description: Auction source/platform. Published sources include "bringatrailer", "carsandbids", "hemmings", "autohunter", "hagerty", "pcarmarket", "acc", "gooding", "rmsothebys", "barrettjackson", "sothebysmotorsport", "dupontregistrylive", "carandclassic", "themarket", "broadarrow", "mbmarket", "mecum", "pistonheads", "collectingcars", "bonhams", "aguttes", "gaaclassiccars", "historics", "kruse". Full coverage: https://oldcarsdata.com/docs/sources#auction-sources. Aguttes, Historics, and Kruse currently have upcoming listings only; pass status=coming_soon. GAA Classic Cars has completed outcomes with unavailable sale prices.

status.description: Auction status; omitted returns completed auctions, coming soon returns only upcoming listings, unsold includes every completed outcome except sold. Input aliases coming_soon, result_unavailable, and reserve_not_met are also accepted; responses keep status names with spaces.

Source labels vary and coverage is partial.

vin.description: Exact VIN match (raw string). Omit make when using this.
